## Duplicate Advisory

This advisory has been withdrawn because it is a duplicate of GHSA-59f9-gqg8-mqpj. This link is maintained to preserve external references.

## Original Description

NLTK before 3.10.4 contains a path traversal vulnerability in save_maxent_params() and load_maxent_params() that bypasses the pathsec filesystem restriction mechanism. Attackers who control the tab_dir argument can read or overwrite model parameter files outside permitted data roots, because the functions call Python's built-in open() directly.
Advisory.Summary: Duplicate Advisory: Path Traversal in save_maxent_params / load_maxent_params Allow Arbitrary File READ/WRITE
